articleTitle: How Birth Control Can Affect Your Mood
imageHeadline: Birth Control Changed Your Mood? Here's Why
imageSubtext: The hormone-mood connection, explained by research
pinTitle: How Birth Control Affects Mood: What the Science Says About Hormones & Mental Health
pinDescription: Hormonal birth control can influence mood in ways that feel confusing or isolating. Learn what research shows about the connection between contraceptives and emotional changes, plus what to watch for and when to talk to your provider.
